comparison.objective: Space three cots three feet apart and arrange pillows head-to-toe; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cot setup tests large-object repositioning, spacing, and alternating orientation. Candidate tests precision hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, counterholding, locking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Cots must meet spacing and pillow-orientation rules; candidate requires quantified safe impacts and lock retention. Detailed cot scoring tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Spatial layout and orientation are meaningfully different from mechanical shock-absorber commissioning.
